resources.string: Offline keyboard settings. Your learning stays on this device.
Keyboard height, spacing and one-handed mode.
Offline speech, model downloads and languages.
Encrypted learning and local data controls.
Offline recognition inside SimpleBoard. Whisper supports multilingual dictation.
Create Documents/SimpleBoard/VoiceModels in internal storage. Select that exact folder once, then keep downloaded models there.
In the picker, open Documents. Create SimpleBoard and then VoiceModels inside it if needed. Open VoiceModels and tap Use this folder.
Folder connected. Save model downloads there, then scan.
Select Documents/SimpleBoard/VoiceModels on internal storage. Other folders are not accepted.
Copying and verifying model. This may take a few minutes…
No supported models found. Move a completed download into VoiceModels without changing its filename.
Scan complete. Choose a voice model below.
Could not verify a model. Check the folder permission, completed download, original filename and free storage. Previously installed models are unchanged.
Only the private installed copy is removed. Delete the download from VoiceModels too if you do not want a later scan to reinstall it.
Links open your browser. Move the finished .bin download into Documents/SimpleBoard/VoiceModels, then scan. SimpleBoard has no Internet permission.
Whisper records first and transcribes after Done; it does not show live words. Speech is transcribed, not translated. Large models need extra RAM and may be slow on a phone.
Done inserts the transcript. Cancel, changing editors or hiding the keyboard discards it. Recording stops after 60 seconds. Audio is never saved.
Grant permission, enable the device microphone switch, then return to a text field and tap the microphone.
Recording offline… Tap Done to transcribe.
No browser or file picker is available.
